_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ove uka Muthu {player_id}, ukalundanga {num_rounds} milonga ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ove na ${pool} ya kusheka mwaka wa milonga iyi kati ya ove na Muthu {other_id}.

Muthu aya nawa:
  - Fanya ofa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Iwa ya vamenya → Ove uka kwata $(pool - X), muthu mwingine uka kwata $X
  - Iwa ya kaninywa → Wawili uka kwata $0
  - Exemplo: [Offer: $3]  or  'Njikala ndi yami. [Offer: $5]'

Muthu aya yamina:
  - Tenga ofa aya na [Accept] kana [Reject]
  - Exemplo: 'Iyi yafwetele. [Accept]'
            'Iyi si yafwetele. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ṋgolo {round_number} ukwenda! ---
Mwene {proposer_id} ndi propouser, Mwene {responder_id} ndi responder.
round.offer: Ṋgolo {round_number}: Mwene {proposer_id} u ṋgola ${offer} kwa Mwene {responder_id} (ukwenda na ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mwene {responder_id} ukwete! Ṋgolo {round_number} ukwete: Mwene {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mwene {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Otango oshilongo: Mwene 0: ${total_0}, Mwene 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Muthu {responder_id} akakataa ofa! Ziku {round_number} mapato: Wote wawili +$0. Majumuisho yabaki: Muthu 0: ${total_0}, Muthu 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Muthu aya nawa a fanya ofa aya na mfumo wa [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Oferesa ya kuvidisha iwe yiwe numeru ya kureva.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ofa lazima iwe kati ya $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ka kuli esapulo lalimue li lekisa okuti mua kongela omanu vaco.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Omunu o tambulula te wa [Accept] ale u [Reject]eca etambululo.

outcome.win: Mwene {winner} ukwete na ${winner_total} otango vs Mwene {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Kisichojulikana! Wote wawili walimaliza na ${total} jumla.
